scaffold_command: brew list xcodegen &>/dev/null || brew install xcodegen && mkdir -p {app_dir}/Sources {app_dir}/Tests {app_dir}/UITests {app_dir}/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset {app_dir}/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AccentColor.colorset
build_command: cd {app_dir} && if [ -f project.yml ]; then xcodegen generate 2>/dev/null; fi; if ls *.xcodeproj 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then SCHEME=$(xcodebuild -list -json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["project"]["schemes"][0])' 2>/dev/null || echo '{app_name}'); xcodebuild -project *.xcodeproj -scheme "$SCHEME" -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ./build build 2>&1; elif [ -f Package.swift ]; then swift build 2>&1; else echo 'ERROR: No project.yml, .xcodeproj, or Package.swift found'; exit 1; fi
launch_command: APP_BUNDLE=$(ls -d {app_dir}/build/Build/Products/Debug/*.app 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$APP_BUNDLE" ]; then open "$APP_BUNDLE"; elif [ -f {app_dir}/Package.swift ]; then BIN_DIR=$(cd {app_dir} && swift build --show-bin-path 2>/dev/null); SPM_EXEC=$(for f in "$BIN_DIR"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$f" ] && echo "$f" && break; done); [ -x "$SPM_EXEC" ] && nohup "$SPM_EXEC" >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi
prompt_addendum: IMPORTANT: Build this as a **SwiftUI macOS** app. Use Swift, SwiftUI, and XcodeGen. Target macOS 14.0+. Use @Observable (not ObservableObject). Name the project '{app_name}'. Create the project in: {app_dir}
